describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal with the overall form of a brown bear covered in dense, shaggy brown fur, shown in right-facing profile standing on four legs. Its head, torso, limbs and paws are bear-like, while its back, neck, sides and tail bear glossy insect features. Dark reddish-brown, smooth, domed beetle-like shell plates are embedded in the fur along the neck, shoulders and mid-body, and two large translucent membranous wings with dark brown veining extend outward from the sides of the body. The rear ends in a long, segmented, armored tail with a forked tip, and rows of narrow dark slits are visible in the fur on the flank and hip.

describe.description: A large four-legged furry mammal standing facing right, with dense shaggy brown fur, a bear-like head with blunt muzzle, dark nose and small rounded ears, four thick bear-like legs ending in broad clawed paws, but with glossy dark reddish-brown beetle-like features: several oval shell plates on the neck, shoulder and flank, two translucent tan veined membranous insect wings spread from the sides of the body, rows of narrow slit-like openings in the fur on the hip and mid-side, and a long down-curving segmented armored tail with small spines ending in two points.
